content.short: Helix is the premier DEX on Injective, offering spot and perpetual trading with institutional-grade features.
content.description: Helix is a leading decentralized exchange on the Injective blockchain, specializing in spot and perpetual markets. It offers a sophisticated order book model that provides traders with a high-performance experience similar to centralized exchanges, but with the security of on-chain settlement. Helix supports institutional-grade trading features, including advanced order types and cross-chain liquidity. Utilizing Injective’s infrastructure ensures zero gas fees for traders, making it a cost-effective solution for high-frequency trading and digital asset management.
